title: Missing dependency in memoized filter
description: Filters products by the current category.
issue_title: Memoized value ignores category changes
issue_description: The filtered list is recomputed only when products change, so changing category leaves stale results on screen.
issue_suggestion: Include category in the dependency list.
issue_code: const visible = useMemo(() => products.filter((product) => product.category === category), [products, category]);

title: Form field missing name attribute
description: Posts a form with browser FormData.
issue_title: Input is missing a name attribute
issue_description: FormData and native form submission use the name attribute, so this value will not be submitted.
issue_suggestion: Add a name attribute to the input.

title: useEffect fetch without error handling
description: Loads a billing summary when the page opens.
issue_title: Request failures are ignored
issue_description: A network or JSON error leaves the component silent and harder to debug.
issue_suggestion: Handle rejected promises and error states explicitly.

title: Derived key from array length
description: Uses a key to force a child editor remount.
issue_title: Key changes for unrelated content edits
issue_description: Using the array length as a key can remount the child unnecessarily when content changes without a length change or vice versa.
issue_suggestion: Use a stable identity key for intentional remounts only.

title: Textarea change handler wrong property
description: Updates draft text from a textarea.
issue_title: Textarea reads a non-existent property
issue_description: The text value lives on event.target.value, so the current handler never captures user input correctly.
issue_suggestion: Read event.target.value.

title: Select onChange missing current value
description: Lets the user choose a timezone.
issue_title: Change handler ignores the selected option
issue_description: The handler just reuses the old state value instead of reading the newly selected option.
issue_suggestion: Use the event's current value.

title: List item button missing type
description: Renders action buttons inside a form row.
issue_title: Button will submit the form by default
issue_description: Buttons inside forms default to submit, which can trigger unwanted form submission.
issue_suggestion: Set the button type explicitly.

title: Stale prop in callback
description: Calls a save handler with the current draft.
issue_title: Auto-save effect captures stale draft and callback
issue_description: Because the effect runs once, the interval keeps using the initial draft and onSave references.
issue_suggestion: Include the reactive values or use a more explicit event pattern.

title: Missing alt on decorative image decision
description: Renders a logo in the header.
issue_title: Image accessibility intent is unclear
issue_description: Without alt text, assistive technology gets no guidance about whether the image is meaningful or decorative.
issue_suggestion: Provide alt text or an empty alt when decorative.

title: Prop mutation via object assignment
description: Updates a settings object passed from a parent.
issue_title: Prop object is mutated directly
issue_description: Mutating props breaks one-way data flow and can create stale UI or confusing parent state.
issue_suggestion: Notify the parent or copy the object instead of mutating props.

title: Anchor used as button
description: Triggers a modal when clicked.
issue_title: Anchor is used for button behavior
issue_description: An anchor without href is the wrong semantic element for an action and is less accessible than a button.
issue_suggestion: Use a button element for actions.

title: useMemo expensive parse missing dependency
description: Parses markdown content for preview.
issue_title: Memoized parse ignores format changes
issue_description: Changing the format prop does not recompute the parsed content because the dependency list is incomplete.
issue_suggestion: Add format to the dependencies.
issue_code: const parsed = useMemo(() => parseContent(content, format), [content, format]);

title: Cleanup order with subscription
description: Subscribes to a chat room on mount.
issue_title: Effect never unsubscribes from the room
issue_description: Changing rooms or unmounting leaves stale subscriptions active.
issue_suggestion: Return a cleanup function that unsubscribes.

title: Input controlled with undefined value
description: Binds a search field to an optional query string.
issue_title: Controlled input may receive undefined
issue_description: Passing undefined as value can cause controlled/uncontrolled warnings.
issue_suggestion: Provide a fallback empty string for the controlled value.

title: Map returns undefined rows
description: Renders only visible notifications.
issue_title: Invisible rows return undefined from map
issue_description: Returning undefined is legal but makes the rendering logic noisier than filtering first.
issue_suggestion: Filter items before mapping them to elements.

title: Checkbox checked from event.value
description: Updates a marketing opt-in checkbox.
issue_title: Checkbox state reads value instead of checked
issue_description: Checkboxes report their boolean state on event.target.checked, not value.
issue_suggestion: Read event.target.checked.

title: Missing key on fragment list
description: Renders a list of shipping options.
issue_title: List items have no key
issue_description: React cannot reconcile list items reliably without a stable key for each one.
issue_suggestion: Add a key to the top-level rendered element.

title: Side effect in useMemo
description: Writes analytics state when a tab changes.
issue_title: Side effect is placed inside useMemo
issue_description: useMemo is for memoized computation, not performing effects like writing to storage.
issue_suggestion: Move the side effect into useEffect.

title: Object state replace forgets previous fields
description: Updates the city inside an address object.
issue_title: State update drops other object fields
issue_description: Replacing the whole object with only city removes country and any other address data.
issue_suggestion: Merge with the previous object when updating one field.

title: Effect subscribes twice in StrictMode due to impure setup
description: Starts a websocket connection in an effect.
issue_title: Effect setup has no matching cleanup
issue_description: Without cleanup, reconnects and StrictMode remount behavior can leave duplicate connections or listeners active.
issue_suggestion: Disconnect or unsubscribe in the cleanup function.

title: Window access during initial render
description: Reads the current URL pathname.
issue_title: Browser global is read during render
issue_description: Direct window access can break server rendering and makes initial render less portable.
issue_suggestion: Read browser globals inside an effect or guard for the browser environment.

title: useRef current in dependency array
description: Restores scroll position when content changes.
issue_title: Ref current is an unstable dependency
issue_description: Putting ref.current in the dependency list does not behave like reactive state and can confuse the effect logic.
issue_suggestion: Depend on the actual reactive inputs instead.

title: Promise returned from event handler ignored
description: Submits analytics when the user clicks export.
issue_title: Async handler errors may go unhandled
issue_description: If onExport is async and rejects, the component provides no place to catch or surface the error.
issue_suggestion: Wrap async handlers when the UI should handle failures.

title: Suspicious dangerouslySetInnerHTML wrapper
description: Renders server-supplied message HTML.
issue_title: HTML is rendered without sanitization
issue_description: Rendering unsanitized HTML can expose the app to XSS if the content is user-controlled or insufficiently trusted.
issue_suggestion: Sanitize or safely transform the HTML before rendering.

title: Mutating Set state in place
description: Tracks selected ids in a Set.
issue_title: Set state is mutated in place
issue_description: React may not detect the change because the same Set object reference is reused.
issue_suggestion: Create a new Set when updating state.

title: Mutating Map state in place
description: Stores prices in a Map held in component state.
issue_title: Map state is mutated in place
issue_description: Updating the existing Map reference can prevent React from recognizing the state change.
issue_suggestion: Clone the Map before setting the new value.

title: Missing aria-label on icon button
description: Shows a button with only an icon.
issue_title: Icon-only button has no accessible name
issue_description: Screen readers need a label to describe what the button does.
issue_suggestion: Add an accessible label to the button.

title: Derived state stored separately
description: Keeps item count in state next to the items array.
issue_title: Derived count state can drift from items
issue_description: Storing count separately from items duplicates state and can fall out of sync under concurrent updates.
issue_suggestion: Derive count from the items array instead of storing it separately.

title: Double submit not prevented
description: Submits a payment form while a request is in flight.
issue_title: Button stays clickable during submission
issue_description: Users can trigger duplicate requests because the button is not disabled while the request is running.
issue_suggestion: Disable the button while saving.

title: useEffect cleanup missing event target
description: Subscribes to visibility changes on the document.
issue_title: Anonymous event handler cannot be removed
issue_description: Without a named handler and cleanup, the listener is leaked across mounts.
issue_suggestion: Store the handler and remove it in cleanup.

title: Precompute state from props once
description: Builds a local options list from incoming items.
issue_title: Local derived state never updates when props change
issue_description: If the items prop changes, the locally stored options remain stuck at the initial value.
issue_suggestion: Derive the options from props or recompute them when props change.
issue_code: const options = items.map((item) => ({ label: item.name, value: item.id }));

title: Manual DOM query in render
description: Counts selected checkboxes for display.
issue_title: Render reads from the global DOM
issue_description: Querying the DOM during render is brittle and breaks React's state-driven model.
issue_suggestion: Derive the count from React state instead of querying the document.

title: Context value recreated each render
description: Provides theme information through context.
issue_title: Context value identity changes every render
issue_description: Recreating the provider value object each render can trigger unnecessary rerenders in consumers.
issue_suggestion: Memoize the context value object.

title: Component returns array without keys
description: Renders a pair of labels side by side.
issue_title: Returned element array has no keys
issue_description: When returning an array of elements, each item still needs a stable key.
issue_suggestion: Add keys to the returned elements or wrap them in a fragment.
